title: A Virgo Will Fix Your Life Uninvited
topic: Virgo zodiac satire: a Virgo will fix your life uninvited
mechanism: Inside a Virgo head there is an office: a giant red WRONG stamp that is never put down, a ruler on the wall marked TWO DEGREES, a FIX IT clipboard whose list never ends, and a tiny I'M TIRED note in a drawer nobody reads.

beats.hook: Anna arrives at the party door holding a label maker under a VIRGO sign
beats.story: Her alphabetical spice rack, her colour-coded closet, her to-do list's to-do list
beats.rise: In ten minutes every jar in Mel's kitchen is labelled; Mel calls it amazing and Anna glows
beats.twist: Anna sees the picture frame on the party wall, tilted two degrees; the music and guests fade away
beats.mechanism: Grey office in her head: stamp WRONG raised forever, ruler TWO DEGREES, clipboard FIX IT, drawer note I'M TIRED
beats.ending: Anna climbs the bookshelf, it topples, she lands on the couch; the frame is straight; she spots Ben and a MAYBE label lands on his forehead

seed.what: The slightly crooked picture frame high on the party wall, behind Mel when she calls the labels amazing
